name: Venicemarathon
summary: The Venice Marathon has been held since 1986, usually in October. It starts at Villa Pisani in Stra, follows the Riviera del Brenta, passes Marghera and Mestre and Parco San Giuliano, and crosses the Ponte della Libertà into Venice. The finish is on the Riva dei Sette Martiri.
courseHighlights: Start at Villa Pisani in Stra
Riviera del Brenta, with Dolo at about km 5 and Mira at km 11
Parco San Giuliano, with about 2 km inside the park
Ponte della Libertà, a bridge nearly 4 km long
Temporary pontoon bridge over the Grand Canal near Punta della Dogana, and finish on the Riva dei Sette Martiri

paceStrategy.summary: The first 30 km are flat and easy to run fast, but the long bridge and the small bridges in Venice make the last 12 km harder. Keep some energy in reserve for the bridges.

segments.terrain: Flat roads along the Riviera del Brenta to Marghera
segments.advice: Run goal pace and avoid going out fast.
Stay relaxed; the park path has some bends.

segments.terrain: Ponte della Libertà, flat and straight
segments.advice: Expect wind and fatigue; hold your effort and break the bridge into segments.

segments.terrain: Venice, with about 14 small bridges and wooden ramps
segments.advice: Shorten your stride on the short bridge rises and keep fuelling.

fuelingNotes: A Venice running guide calls the bridge from km 32 to 37 the hardest section, so take a gel before it, around km 30 to 31. Aid-station positions are in the official runner's guide.
tips: Ramps are built over small bridges so runners do not run on stairs, but the rises are short and steep, so save your legs
GPS can fail near km 24, where a railway underpass runs; follow the course distance markers
The route may avoid Piazza San Marco if the tide is high
Bridge wind on the Ponte della Libertà can slow you; run with other runners

faq.question: Is the Venice Marathon flat?
faq.answer: Mostly. A running guide says the course has no significant elevation change, but the Ponte della Libertà and about 14 small bridges in Venice add short rises.

faq.question: When is the Venice Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is usually held in October, on a Sunday.

faq.question: Where does the Venice Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: It starts at Villa Pisani in Stra and finishes on the Riva dei Sette Martiri in Venice.
